concept: Keeping your word matters, even when it's hard or inconvenient
source_inspiration: original content, informed by Tokkatsu-style lived-practice principles — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short illustrated tale where a character promises to help a friend, then faces a tempting reason to break the promise
exercise.reflection_prompt: What do you think the character should do, and why?
exercise.practice: Student identifies a small promise they can keep this week and reports back next session

assessment.success_marker: student can explain, in their own words, why keeping the promise mattered to the character
